title: Prevent cross-snapshot stablecoin component context mixing
instructions: Fix one verified PIT/context handoff correctness defect in build_stablecoin_context: currently it independently picks newest component_supply_usd, component_price_usd, and component_supply_change_{1d,7d,30d}_usd per symbol, so when a later DefiLlama component snapshot has supply but omits price/change, older-snapshot price/change values are silently attached to the newer supply. This falsely inflates peg_price_coverage/change_coverage and omits missing_fields. Choose the latest PIT-visible supply observation per symbol as the anchor. Only attach component price/change observations belonging to that same source-native snapshot: match asset, source, effective_at_ms, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms and (when present) provenance.stablecoin_id to the selected supply row. Select matching metrics from the PIT-visible normalized rows, rather than taking independently latest per metric across snapshots. If a metric is absent from the anchored snapshot, emit None and list it in missing_fields; recompute peg_deviation_bps, change and price coverage, tracked change totals and weighted peg statistics from only matched metrics. Do not invent or forward-fill missing metrics. Older observations must remain visible in raw/audit and source_evidence; do not change collectors, PIT filtering, dedup/revision selection, context-only status, scoring inputs, or frozen scoring. Add a deterministic no-network pytest regression in test_v1_handoff.py: parse an older DefiLlama snapshot with USDT supply+price+1d change, then a later same-day snapshot with newer supply but no price/change; at the later as_of assert latest supply retained, price_usd/change_1d_usd/peg_deviation_bps None, corresponding missing_fields present, peg_price_coverage=0, change_coverage['1d']=0, weighted_abs_peg_deviation_bps None, tracked_change_1d_usd None; at the earlier as_of assert earlier price/change remain visible. Include a same-symbol other-source price observation to prove cross-source non-mixing if feasible. Keep existing complete-snapshot tests passing. Do not alter handoff scoring or other Specialist families.
